searchRun.provider: Public Google and Bing result review plus direct source verification
limitations: Bing's live interface returned no usable organic result body for the focused query, so no claim depends on it.

Paid search cache was not refreshed because this run is not the scheduled Sunday research refresh.

sources.title: GS1 — Who is responsible for numbering trade items?
sources.use: Primary source for the normal responsibility of the brand owner, including an importer or wholesaler selling under its own brand.

sources.title: GS1 GTIN Management Standard
sources.use: Primary standard for reviewing new products, declared content, brand and pack or case quantity changes; no local legal conclusion is inferred.

sources.title: GS1 — What should I check to ensure good quality barcodes?
sources.use: Primary guidance for check digit, quiet zones, contrast, height, substrate obstacles, damage and placement checks.

sources.title: GS1 General Specifications
sources.use: Normative reference for barcode placement and for avoiding seams, folds, edges, staples and conflicting identifiers.

sources.title: Reddit r/barcodes — who is responsible for the barcode, brand or overseas manufacturer?
sources.use: Natural buyer wording about giving an allocated number to a contract manufacturer; not used as standards evidence.
